svg.title: Under the lens: False-colour micrograph
svg.desc: Under the lens (2D): a circular field of view at 400 times magnification, where crystal micro-filaments stream past like a river seen from above, in false teal and magenta. Only the sharp teal plane is solid; the blurred magenta planes above and below pass through. The focus reticle threads a gap as bright charge pulses run along the filaments, two of three steadiness points remain, and the ring around the lens is two-thirds full toward the next captured plate.
